citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015, USGS Open-File Report 2016-1192
evidence_used: Covers M7+ events through 2015 including 2000-08-06 M7.4 (usp0009xzy), 2009-08-09 M7.1 (usp000h04j), 2010-12-21 M7.4 Bonin outer-rise (usp000hr97), and 2015-05-30 M7.8 deep Bonin (us20002ki3).
limitations_and_caveats: Scope limited to M7+ through 2015; verify verbatim event summary pages before freeze.

citation: Hasterok et al. (2022), New Maps of Global Geological Provinces and Tectonic Plates, Earth-Science Reviews 231, 104069
evidence_used: Surface polygon overlays showing 5 events in Izu Bonin subplate, 8 deep slab events projecting beneath Philippine subplate, and 1 outer-rise event (usp000hr97) in Pacific plate.
limitations_and_caveats: 2D surface polygons misclassify deep westward-dipping Izu-Bonin slab events (292-496 km) under the overriding Philippine plate.

citation: Bird (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027
evidence_used: Surface plate boundary reference for Pacific-Philippine Sea convergence along the Izu-Bonin Trench.
limitations_and_caveats: Surface plate boundary only; does not represent 3D slab contours.

citation: Faccenna et al. (2018), Dynamics of the Ryukyu/Izu-Bonin-Marianas double subduction system, Tectonophysics 746, 229-238
evidence_used: Geodynamic framework for the steeply dipping subducted Pacific slab beneath the Izu-Bonin arc and its northern triple-junction transition.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional synthesis; individual event mechanisms require ComCat detail product verification.
